title: Casino War
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium illustrated casino catalogue title card.
Primary request: Create ONE original polished Casino War title-card image, wide 2:1 landscape (1536x768 composition), opaque.
Scene/backdrop: luxurious emerald-green casino felt within a curved brown leather and polished antique-gold table rail. Restrained burgundy ambience beyond the rail. Warm ivory and champagne gold highlights.
Subject: exactly TWO opposed warm-ivory playing cards, one Ace of Spades and one Ace of Hearts, angled inward toward one another as an elegant head-to-head card duel. Clean black spade on one, deep red heart on the other, single large central suit symbols and matching A/suit corner indices upper-left and rotated lower-right. No court portraits or people. A few discreet casino chips with cream edge stripes accent the bottom of the scene, no numbers.
Style/medium: sophisticated professionally illustrated game key art, precise readable cards, softly modeled materials and restrained lighting. Premium collection quality; not screenshot, UI mockup, clipart or piles of money.
Composition/framing: wide 2:1. Two large inward-angled cards flank a central two-line title with quiet dark felt behind its letters. Keep BOTH entire cards and ALL letters within central 80% width / central 70% height, with at least 10% horizontal and 15% vertical safe margins. Strong central hierarchy; readable at 240px width.
Text (verbatim): "Casino War". Render exactly these two words once in large cream-gold serif letters on two lines, Casino above War, restrained beveled edges, strong contrast.
Constraints: no other words, no swords, shields, battlefield or military props, no flames, no religious motifs, no logos, no watermark, no payout claims/slogans, no buttons or fake interface. One image only.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected master and final 768x384 WebP. Exact Casino War title, two coherent opposed aces (spades/hearts) with clean matching indices, emerald felt and brown/gold rail. No military props, court portraits, slogans or UI. Title and card faces remain safe in central composition; chips are decorative edge elements.
visualCheck.thumbnail: Inspected at 240x120. Exact two-line title and opposing ace symbols read clearly.
visualCheck.compression: 50,460 bytes; WebP quality 84; below 120 KB ideal target.
